newsitem.title: USA: R.R. Donnelley names chief executive officer.
newsitem.headline: R.R. Donnelley names chief executive officer.

text.p: R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co said Wednesday William Davis was named chief executive officer, effective immediately. Davis will become chairman following Donnelley's March 27 board meeting, it added.
Davis, 53, is a 20-year executive with Emerson Electric Co, it added. Most recently, he was senior executive vice president at Emerson, responsible for the Process Control Group.

"His (Davis') outside perspective is an ideal complement to the unparalleled printing expertise of R.R. Donnelley's existing management team, and his strong leadership will be central to executing -- and accelerating -- the solid strategic plans we have in place today," John Richman, acting chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Richman was named acting chairman and chief executive officer in October, replacing John Walter, who resigned to become president and chief operating officer of AT&T Corp.
R.R. Donnelley, with 1996 sales of $6.6 billion, manages, reproduces and distributes print and digital information for the publishing, retailing, merchandising and information-technology markets.

Last year, R.R. Donnelley was targeted in a $500 million federal class-action lawsuit that alleged racial discrimination based on layoffs, promotions and wages. The company said previously the lawsuit was filed in connection with a 1993 plant closing and has denied the allegations.
